projects.name: Qualcomm ELD contributions
projects.summary: Four merged fixes in Qualcomm's LLVM-based ELF linker: GNU option compatibility, PHDRS/FILEHDR layout, native ARM/AArch64 LTO saved objects, and linker-script warning locations.
projects.status: 4 merged fixes · focused regression tests across 6 target configurations
projects.flow: Object files + linker script → symbol and section layout → ELF executable
features: Accepted numeric GNU -O compatibility options while keeping LTO optimization controls independent.
Guarded ELF/program-header address assignment when a linker script omits those headers from the output layout.
Preserved native ARM/AArch64 LTO objects with --save-temps and added line numbers to PROVIDE/PROVIDE_HIDDEN redeclaration warnings.
Reproduced failures and added regression coverage for x86-64, Hexagon, ARM, AArch64, RV32, and RV64 configurations.
projects.notes: ELD merge status refreshed on 30 October 2026. The linked PRs record focused regression validation, not full-suite runs.

projects.name: Legal Lens 2.0
projects.summary: A legal research workspace that connects natural-language questions to page-level evidence in a 1,871-page historical IPC PDF. Contributed hybrid retrieval, a cited assistant, and research-brief exports.
projects.flow: PDF pages → BM25 + MiniLM indexes → reciprocal rank fusion → cited answer or source excerpts
features: Combined lexical and semantic ranking with reciprocal rank fusion, keeping PDF page references attached to retrieved passages.
Added retrieval-augmented generation with page-linked citations and a document-excerpt fallback when generation is unavailable.
Implemented local scope/intent classification using MiniLM embeddings and logistic regression, plus cited research-brief export.
projects.notes: Built around a historical source corpus. Retrieval-quality and latency benchmarks are not claimed; the repository documents provider setup and reproduction.

projects.name: LLVM BugSquad
projects.summary: An LLVM investigation workspace that brings compiler inputs, model-assisted routing, isolated compiler recipes, and inspectable evidence into one local interface.
projects.status: Synthetic replay demo · live model/worker integration validation pending
projects.flow: Input IR → FastAPI coordinator → replay/model routing + compiler worker → events and evidence ZIP
features: Stored run history and ordered events in SQLite, with resumable server-sent events and cancellation.
Implemented fixed opt, FileCheck, and lit recipes with resource-limited Docker workers and captured artifacts.
Exported reports and ZIP bundles with input/artifact hashes and worker image identity for reproducible investigation.
projects.notes: The demo uses synthetic replay scenarios and substituted contract tests. Diagnosis is a deterministic evidence summary; autonomous patching is not implemented.

projects.name: NewsScript
projects.summary: A news-to-script workspace that collects RSS stories, removes duplicates, ranks articles, and turns selected stories into structured video-script drafts.
projects.status: Local prototype · provider integration and deployment hardening pending
projects.flow: RSS → cleanup and ranking → saved articles → model or template draft → text/PDF export
features: Implemented RSS ingestion, URL/title-similarity deduplication, heuristic ranking, and a process-local cache.
Added bookmarks and stored scripts with short/long formats backed by Prisma and SQLite.
Integrated optional Gemini/OpenAI generation with a local template fallback, plus copy, text, and PDF exports.
projects.notes: Ranking uses heuristic signals, including synthetic engagement inputs. The assistant uses article metadata as context rather than a vector retrieval pipeline.

projects.name: MoodPet
projects.summary: A native Windows companion that combines an animated desktop pet with focus sessions, local activity history, persistent streaks, and a productivity dashboard.
projects.flow: Manual timer + activity signals → focus state → SQLite → pet, charts, and history
features: Built pause/resume focus timers with partial-session recording and a tray interface.
Added daily charts, 7/30-day history, a 12-week calendar, CSV exports, and persistent XP/streaks.
Stored aggregate durations and sessions locally, with unit tests for focus and persistence behavior.
projects.notes: Activity classification uses personal heuristics. The source contains local setup instructions; a packaged public release is not listed.

projects.name: C++ Concepts Lab
projects.summary: An interactive C++ and STL learning lab with step-through container illustrations, an editable coding workspace, quizzes, and an optional Gemini tutor.
projects.status: Public learning interface · external compiler/model services required for those features
projects.flow: Lesson + visual simulation → editable code → Wandbox output; lesson context → optional AI tutor
features: Created data-driven memory/container simulations that explain concepts step by step.
Connected the editor to Wandbox for C++, C, Java, and Python, separating compiler output from program output.
Added timed quizzes, a browser-local leaderboard, and sanitized Markdown for assistant responses.
projects.notes: Visualizations are teaching simulations, not execution traces. The tutor receives lesson context directly rather than using RAG.

projects.name: Quizzes by Iron
projects.summary: An event-driven multiplayer quiz with host-controlled rooms, QR-code joins, timed questions, server-side scoring, and live leaderboards.
projects.status: Web application · room state held in one server process
projects.flow: Host/player clients ↔ Socket.IO rooms → timers and scoring → answer feedback and leaderboard
features: Built separate host and player views with six-character room codes and QR join links.
Implemented 20-second question timers, time-based points, submission counts, and room-scoped updates.
Checked duplicate lobby names and repeated answers while keeping scoring on the server.
projects.notes: Rooms are in memory; host disconnection or server restart ends continuity. The public frontend is available; no scale or latency measurements are claimed.

projects.name: C++ Filesystem & Concurrency Lab
projects.summary: A C++17 command interpreter exploring the differences between sequential and threaded filesystem operations, recursive traversal, and coordinated output.
projects.flow: Command parser → sequential/threaded command classes → filesystem traversal and operations
features: Implemented command classes for cd, ls, cp, mv, and rm with recursive directory handling.
Compared sequential and threaded executables, coordinating listing output with a mutex.
Included workload-generation and timing scripts to explore filesystem and concurrency behavior.
projects.notes: This is a filesystem interpreter, not a POSIX shell. The README explains the large benchmark workload and implementation limits; no reproducible speedup is claimed.

projects.name: GPT-2 Review Summarization
projects.summary: A notebook experiment fine-tuning GPT-2 to turn Amazon Fine Food Reviews into short summaries, covering data preparation, training, checkpointing, and generation.
projects.flow: Reviews → preprocessing and split → GPT-2 fine-tuning → checkpoint → summary generation
features: Prepared review–TL;DR–summary sequences with a custom dataset and data loaders.
Implemented an AdamW training loop, learning-rate scheduling, checkpoint save/load, and prompt-based generation.
Included ROUGE/BLEU evaluation code and documented prompt-leakage and batching issues that need correction.
projects.notes: Historical scores are not presented as valid quality measurements. The repository documents reproduction gaps and does not include a packaged inference service.

projects.name: Real Estate Aggregator
projects.summary: A PHP/Slim property marketplace connecting searchable listings, account workflows, MySQL persistence, Razorpay integration, and generated PDF contracts.
projects.flow: PHP/Slim routes → account and property workflows → MySQL + payment/email/PDF integrations
features: Built listing creation/editing and filters for location, budget, availability, and amenities.
Implemented registration, login, email OTP/reset flows, and account views.
Added Razorpay order creation/signature checks, stored payment records, and TCPDF contract generation.
projects.notes: The repository documents setup and remaining authorization/payment-consistency work. This is a prototype, without a verified production payment deployment.

projects.name: Bioinformatics Literature & Graph Explorer
projects.summary: A related pair of research tools: an extremophile literature-mining pipeline and an interactive chemical–gene graph that makes prepared relationships and publication references easier to explore.
projects.flow: PubMed literature → entity cleanup and PMID joins → co-occurrence records → interactive graph
features: Organized gene and chemical metadata, joined records by publication, and filtered co-occurring sentences.
Assigned rule-based interaction labels and exported inspectable research tables.
Built chemical filters, directed labeled edges, component coloring, and a metadata sidebar with PubMed references.
projects.notes: The graph visualizes prepared relationships; co-occurrence is not causation. The notebooks use environment-specific paths and do not constitute a validated biomedical prediction model.

projects.name: Android Image Classifier
projects.summary: An Android app that runs a bundled quantized MobileNet model locally to classify a selected gallery image and display its predicted label.
projects.flow: Gallery image → 224 × 224 RGB buffer → local MobileNet inference → predicted label
features: Built gallery selection, image preview, result display, and reset in a Compose interface.
Prepared model inputs with resizing and RGB byte-buffer conversion.
Bundled the TensorFlow Lite model and label assets for local inference.
projects.notes: Uses a pretrained model rather than training a new network. It classifies selected images; device accuracy and latency benchmarks are not claimed.

projects.name: Voice–Vision: Image Captioning
projects.summary: A Flask image-captioning prototype combining InceptionV3 visual features with an LSTM language decoder to turn an uploaded image into a caption.
projects.flow: Uploaded image → InceptionV3 features → token-by-token LSTM decoding → caption view
features: Implemented browser uploads and 299 × 299 image preprocessing.
Extracted 2,048-dimensional visual features and mapped generated tokens through a vocabulary.
Rendered generated captions in a Flask web interface with supporting model/vocabulary assets.
projects.notes: The implemented workflow is image-to-caption generation. Reproduction needs legacy dependency and model-path validation; voice synthesis and quality metrics are not claimed.

projects.name: Decrypter & Analyzer
projects.summary: An educational PHP toolkit exploring hash demonstrations and basic website configuration inspection through browser-based forms and result panels.
projects.status: Educational prototype for authorized lab use
projects.flow: Form input → PHP hash or configuration-inspection handlers → structured result views
features: Included MD5, SHA, and bcrypt examples alongside dictionary/rainbow-table demonstrations.
Built result views for HTTP headers, WHOIS, CORS, and clickjacking-related configuration checks.
Connected input forms, inspection handlers, and result panels in a PHP web application.
projects.notes: Hash lookup demonstrations do not reverse encryption. Individual configuration checks are educational tools rather than a comprehensive security audit.

contributions.name: Qualcomm ELD
contributions.summary: Four merged fixes across GNU compatibility, header layout, native LTO output, and linker-script diagnostics.

items.title: #2011 · GNU numeric -O compatibility
items.detail: Unblocked warning-sensitive Meson links while leaving --lto-O controls independent. Regression coverage across six target configurations.

items.title: #2065 · PHDRS/FILEHDR layout crash
items.detail: Guarded header address assignment when a linker script omits headers from the output layout; checked both header combinations.

items.title: #2129 · Native LTO saved objects
items.detail: Preserved native ARM/AArch64 object emission with --save-temps; covered full LTO, ThinLTO, and explicit assembly output.

items.title: #2207 · Linker-script warning locations
items.detail: Included source line numbers in duplicate PROVIDE and PROVIDE_HIDDEN warnings; both updated regressions passed across six target configurations.

items.title: #2134 · AArch64 feature flags
items.detail: Preserved BTI/PAC flags across multiple sections in one input. The regression failed before the fix; 18 focused runs passed after it.

items.title: #2127 · Contributor build guidance
items.detail: Documented LLVM main alignment and space-free source/build paths following hands-on WSL setup and maintainer discussion.

contributions.note: Test results are recorded in the PRs and cover focused regressions, not the full ELD suite. Open changes remain under review.

contributions.name: AI tooling & application libraries
contributions.summary: Working on the details that make AI tools and interactive applications easier to use reliably.

items.title: smolagents #2949 · Tool export validation
items.detail: Submitted AST validation for tuple/list/nested/starred context-manager aliases, with export/reload regressions. The PR records 70 focused pytest passes.

items.title: React ChatBotify #366 · History sanitization
items.detail: Submitted chat-history HTML sanitization, URL checks, and an optional sanitizer callback with tests.

contributions.note: These are submitted contributions, not merged fixes. The smolagents change is a draft awaiting scope acceptance and contributor review; full-suite and Python-version-matrix runs are not claimed.
